messages.content: {"problem": "给定一组小写单词：afuza，agugufi，erizuy，igeceyo，kiwuhu，meloyop，nubodeh，sezef，soxiqe，xssoho。\n现在按如下规则定义新的字母表顺序：把字母 j、w、b 按给出的先后顺序整体移到字母表最前面，其余字母保持原来的相对顺序不变。随后按该新字母表的字典序对这些单词进行降序排序。\n请写出排序后的完整序列，用英文逗号+空格分隔，例如：word1, word2, word3。", "canonical_answer": "xssoho, soxiqe, sezef, nubodeh, meloyop, kiwuhu, igeceyo, erizuy, agugufi, afuza", "attempts": [{"panel": 0, "sample": 0, "answer": "xssoho, soxiqe, sezef, nubodeh, meloyop, kiwuhu, igeceyo, erizuy, agugufi, afuza", "certificate": "新字母表为 j, w, b, a, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, k, l, m, n, o, p, q, r, s, t, u, v, x, y, z。按首字母降序：x > s > n > m > k > i > e > a；s 组中 o > e，所以 soxiqe > sezef；a 组中 g > f，所以 agugufi > afuza。"}]}
